map.简支梁与连续梁的弯矩公式为何不同？: Why do the moment formulas differ between simply supported and continuous girders?
map.连续梁因中间支座产生负弯矩，内支点弯矩最大（(g+q)L²/12）、跨中较小（(: A continuous girder develops negative moments at the intermediate supports, so the interior support moment is largest ((g+q)L²/12) and the midspan smaller ((g+q)L²/24); a simply supported beam is largest only at midspan ((g+q)L²/8). The bridge type choice directly affects the reinforcement quantity and cost.
map.桥墩数为何是跨数减一？: Why is the number of piers the span count minus one?

map.输入总长 300 m、跨数 5、三跨及以上连续梁、恒载 150 kN/m、活载: Input total length 300 m, 5 spans, continuous beam with 3+ spans, dead load 150 kN/m, live load 60 kN/m: span L=60 m, 4 intermediate piers, 2 abutments, 6 support positions in total, total load w=210 kN/m. Interior support M=wL²/12=210×3600/12=63,000 kN·m; interior-span midspan M=wL²/24=31,500 kN·m. A two-span continuous beam must not use these coefficients: use interior support M=wL²/8 and midspan M=9wL²/128; for 300 m in 2 spans, L=150 m and w=210 kN/m, interior support 590,625 kN·m and midspan 332,226.6 kN·m. Edge spans and different support conditions need separate analysis.

map.三跨及以上等跨连续梁可近似取内支点 M=(g+q)L²/12、内跨跨中 M=(g: For 3+ equal continuous spans, approximate interior support M=(g+q)L²/12 and interior-span midspan M=(g+q)L²/24; a two-span beam has one interior support and uses M=(g+q)L²/8 at support and 9(g+q)L²/128 at midspan. Simple span midspan M=(g+q)L²/8. Do not mix coefficients across span counts.
map.桥墩数为何是跨数减一？支承位置有多少？: Why are piers n−1? How many support positions?
map.n 跨连续布置有 n-1 个中间桥墩加 2 个桥台；本工具“中间桥墩”只计 n-: An n-span layout has n−1 intermediate piers plus 2 abutments. This tool counts only intermediate piers (n−1) and lists 2 abutments separately. Total support positions are n+1 (5 spans → 4 intermediate piers + 2 abutments = 6 supports); pier count is not the total number of supports.
